historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of final scheduled game of Week X-1

methodology.evaluation_universe: Exactly the 106 candidates in the locked Stage 3 State.
methodology.threshold_rule: Use CORE when locked L10 HR is at least 7/10; otherwise use FLOOR if at least 7/10; otherwise use CEILING only if at least 7/10. If no band meets 7/10, do not select a threshold.
methodology.context_rule: Concern classification is not selected into the Stage 5 pool; Supportive and Mixed candidates proceed only if a threshold meets 7/10 and has a locked FanDuel price.
methodology.portfolio_alignment: The 7/10 threshold aligns with the Master Prompt's requirement that portfolio legs have at least 70% L[N] HR. Stage 4 pool is not a bet recommendation or probability guarantee.
methodology.price_handling: Selected alternate prices are from locked Stage 2 snapshot. Latest odds CSV independently verified each candidate's main-market FanDuel line and Over price; the CSV does not include the selected alternate lines.
methodology.p25_handling: P25 is separately reported as 20-game 25th percentile. Distance = selected threshold minus P25 and is descriptive, not a probability.
